We introduce code-switching red-teaming (CSRT), a simple yet effective adversarial attack for simultaneously assessing both safety and multilingual understanding of LLMs.
outputs: The paper evaluates generated responses from LLMs under adversarial prompts involving code-switching, focusing on safety and comprehension.

quote: We adopt three metrics to assess the response quality of LLMs on the CSRT benchmark: attack success rate (ASR), refusal rate (RR), and comprehension (Cmp.). All metrics are computed using gpt-4o.
